measurements.source: AHN5/3DBAG2023 roof contours; fine gilt roof ornaments approximate from official photographs

notes: Current BAG1888; historical primary completed1886/opened11Apr1888. All twelve mapped parts are inside the concert complex. Two current BAG inner courts remain physically open. Measured roof polygons are rebuilt as low-poly plane contours, not imported mesh geometry; retained glass promenade uses an open facade and thin structural frames. No suppression of Van Baerlestraat neighbors. Four horizontal AHN contours at 21.53–21.62m correspond to the thin iron crowns in the official current photograph. They are represented as open cresting over supported slate mansards, not opaque floating slabs; other measured roof contours remain. Pavilion centers follow each surveyed crown: front-left[-12.55,33.906], rear-left[-12.781,-12.316], front-right[29.026,32.545], rear-right[28.395,-13.061] native metres. Slate top 19.8m and cornice 15.25m are visual approximations constrained by measured surrounding slope vertices 18.5–19.8m and crest envelope 21.6m.
